$comment: Products shown as cards in README › Product ecosystem. One entry per product a user or operator can open. `state` is one of: running, candidate, planned, dormant; `stateNote` says where and on what evidence (docs/status). Edit, then `npm run docs:write`.

products.name: Website
products.tagline: Challenges, markets, rulebook, economy, governance and learning in five languages.
highlights: Certificate verification by serial or QR

products.name: Web Terminal
products.tagline: One trading workspace for Prop and Perpetual with separate accounts and records.
highlights: Vela charts with Openfund Pine indicators
Order panel with server risk preview

products.name: Market intelligence
products.tagline: Trade Radar, Market Heatmap and Hybrid Footprint built on public market data.
highlights: Large-trade tape, leaderboards and whale positions
Perpetual-market treemap by volume or OI
Order flow beside unchanged Gains candles

products.name: Tools Center
products.tagline: Ten browser-side calculators for sizing, risk, funding and journal review.
highlights: Risk/reward, risk of ruin, prop drawdown

products.name: Open Trade
products.tagline: Lightweight Electron desktop workspace with one to four independent Vela charts.
highlights: Watchlist, floating ticket and positions strip

products.name: Backstage
products.tagline: Bilingual owner console for Prop business operations and website content.
highlights: Coupons, partners, finance and audit trail

products.name: Certificates
products.tagline: Purchase, completion and payout certificates derived from recorded evidence.
highlights: Verifiable by serial number or QR code
Issued from server records, not client messages

products.name: Openfund Protocol
products.tagline: Planned venue aggregation and routing; today a dormant imported code base.

products.name: Open Oracle
products.tagline: Openfund's own multi-source price aggregation and discovery.
highlights: Gains, Hyperliquid and GMX in one composite price
Execution gate: divergent or stale prices never trade
